# Kessel 0.10.0 — Page Tools, Bookmarks & Passwords
Kessel 0.10.0 brings a command palette and a full set of page tools, reader view, a feed reader, a bookmark manager, site permissions, a download manager and a much stronger password manager. Feature progress stands at **64%** of the 1,045 features in [FEATURES.md](https://github.com/puss-in-boots-org/kessel-browser/blob/main/FEATURES.md) (523 done, 57 built and awaiting their first Windows run, 54 partly done). Features that need an online account or a server of your own (sync, cloud, AI services, auto-update) are left out on purpose.

## What's new
- **Command palette (F2):** every command, searchable, with recent ones first. Command chains run several commands in one go, from the palette or a mouse gesture.
- **Page tools:**
  - Screenshots: what's in view (Ctrl+Shift+S), the whole page, or a part you drag out. Save, copy or both, or open in the screenshot editor: pen, highlighter, arrows, boxes, text, blur and crop.
  - Save as PDF, with landscape, backgrounds and headers as settings.
  - Your own CSS per site; colour filters (dark, sepia, grayscale…) per site or everywhere; hide an element for good; auto-reload.
  - Mouse gestures, each mappable to any command; open links from the keyboard; skip AMP pages; copy links without tracking; paste and go.
  - Highlights and notes on any page (Ctrl+Shift+H), found again when you come back. Notes stay out of the page's markup, so its scripts can't read them.
  - Pause everything: stops every video and mutes every tab.
  - A missing page (404) offers its Wayback Machine copy.
- **Reader view (F9):** the article on its own, rebuilt so nothing from the site runs. You choose the font, size, width, line height and colours. Read aloud with your choice of voice and speed.
- **Feeds (`kessel://feeds`):** follow a site's RSS, Atom or JSON feed. Kessel fetches them itself, with no account. Unread counts and OPML import/export.
- **Search:** keywords like `yt cats` or `w Budapest`, your own search engines (any can be the default), and sites' own search engines offered in one click. Right-click to search for selected text or an image (Google Lens, Bing, Yandex or TinEye).
- **Bookmarks (Ctrl+Shift+O):** a bookmark manager:
  - nested folders, shown on the bookmarks bar as menus;
  - tags, notes, search and sorting;
  - drag to move or reorder; a star popup to file a bookmark as you save it;
  - duplicate and broken-link finders;
  - HTML import/export and daily backups.
- **Site permissions:** Kessel's own prompt for camera, microphone, location, notifications, the clipboard and more. Answers are kept per site and are editable in Settings → Site permissions, alongside your defaults. Nothing is kept from private windows.
- **Downloads:** progress, pause, resume, cancel, try again, show in folder, search and sort. Choose your download folder, or be asked where to save each file.
- **Passwords:**
  - Kessel offers to save or update a password as you sign in.
  - Password health flags weak and reused passwords.
  - An opt-in breach check against Have I Been Pwned sends only the first 5 characters of each password's hash.
  - CSV export asks for your master password first.
  - The autofill chip now works on websites.
- **Import:** Edge, Vivaldi and Firefox join Opera GX, Opera, Brave and Chrome. Bookmarks keep their folders. You can bring over history, open tabs (as saved tab groups), extensions, and Firefox's cookies and passwords (when it has no Primary Password). History and open tabs can be exported too.
- **Tabs and privacy:**
  - Startup pages.
  - Only the active tab plays sound (optional); peek at a link in a small window.
  - Tabs you haven't looked at in days can close themselves.
  - Chosen sites can be forgotten when their last tab closes.
- **Network and settings:**
  - Proxy: none, your own HTTP or SOCKS proxy, or a PAC script.
  - Your own engine switches.
  - Settings backup and restore.

## Fixes
- Full screen from a maximized window now covers the whole screen and comes back maximized.
- A tab switch no longer throws at its end, which broke closing tabs, groups and workspaces.
- Pausing a download no longer marks it as failed.
- Downloads use the name the site gave the file.
- Restoring settings from an unrelated JSON file no longer resets every setting.

## Downloads
- **Windows:** `Kessel_0.10.0_x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Kessel_0.10.0_x64_en-US.msi`.
- **Android:** `Kessel_0.10.0_android.apk` (install directly) or `Kessel_0.10.0_android.aab` (Play Store bundle).
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
